min: Quickstart oddity during workshop: starter says WS connected in the browser and shows composer, but sending the first message fails with 402 Payment Required. Console shows workspace status 'Pending billing'. Anyone seen websocket appear live while REST calls are blocked?

rita: Yep. Historically the handshake path gives a fast OK while the token is actually blocked for API usage until billing/invite is resolved. Sounds like a UX leak.

noah: Can you run `redwood whoami` and paste output? Also the failing response body from network tab would help.

min: whoami outputs: "org: acme-pilot (pending)". Network body: {"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace billing not configured"}. The UI enables briefly then errors.

rita: Workarounds: add payment method or accept the workspace invite. For workshops we usually spin a throwaway workspace that already has billing accepted.

infra-bot: :information_source: infra ticket INF-907 created to align websocket auth with REST org-state checks to avoid false connected state.

noah: I'll add a small client change for quickstart: call GET /v1/org on boot and block enabling composer until org.state === 'active'. I'll open DEVX-700 with repro + screenshots.

min: Thanks — that should reduce confusion for new users. I'll PR the starter patch after lunch.

rita: Also adding a quick note to the starter README: if you see 'Connected' but first call fails, check workspace billing and accept any pending invites.

min: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter/pull/52 (org-state guard on client boot) :thumbsup:
